mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decrease.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines continuously for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals tightening labor market conditions that boost corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE declines >0.2pp MoM, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and business investment, jointly predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS both rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during manufacturing slowdowns signals reduced corporate output capacity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 100 periods, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising non-farm payrolls trend (PAYEMS > 100k monthly increase) indicates expanding labor market conditions that support corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS increases >100k monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers market anticipation of Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals strong economic momentum, jointly predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and GDPC1 both rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) during manufacturing expansion signals robust output growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days as corporate profits accelerate.
failure_condition: In INDPRO > 100 periods, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of cases.
